name: com.pushwoosh.location.foregroundservice.ForegroundService
description: Pushwoosh Location starts this foreground service when background location collection is enabled, including when it resumes location work after a device reboot. It shows an ongoing notification so the SDK can keep location work active under Android foreground-service rules.
disableEffect: Pushwoosh background location collection may stop, so location-based Pushwoosh messages may no longer arrive.
